hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that lets a creator initialize a Uniswap v4 ETH/token pool and seed a one-sided (token-only) liquidity position. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero deltas; actual pool mutations are performed via an unlockCallback driven by creator-gated addLiquidity/removeLiquidity entry points.
